speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin. To determine the cause of this jaundice, how many hours after birth did you first notice these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic Jaundice)

The timeline of two days of worsening jaundice in a 2-week-old who is exclusively breastfed, with normal weight gain and gestational age, is highly suggestive of breastfeeding jaundice. Please confirm if the baby has had adequate wet diapers (at least 6 per day) and stool output to rule out dehydration or obstruction.
